title: Retrieval-augmented generation
content: RAG retrieves relevant external material at request time and gives it to the model as context. It is useful when facts change or citations to source material are important.

title: Fine-tuning
content: Fine-tuning adjusts model behavior using training examples. It is generally better suited to stable behavior, style, or task patterns than to frequently changing factual knowledge.

title: Evaluation guidance
content: Evaluate research assistants for factual correctness, source quality, tool-selection accuracy, latency, cost, and output-schema validity.
